summary_rationale: BrightSpring Health Services (BTSG) has successfully transitioned from a leveraged KKR/Walgreens LBO roll-up into a focused, rapidly deleveraging specialty pharmacy (Onco360/CareMed/PharMerica) and home/community clinical care platform. Continuing revenue compounded ~29.6% annually from FY2023 ($7.69B) to FY2025 ($12.91B) and is guided to $15.9B-$16.125B in FY2026, while Adjusted EBITDA is guided to $850M-$860M (up ~38%-39% over FY2025's $617.6M). Divesting ResCare Community Living for $835M (March 2026) and acquiring 107 DOJ-divested Amedisys/LHC home health branches ($239M) upgraded asset quality and cut net leverage to 1.79x by Q3 2026. Key operational KPIs—155+ LDDs, pharmacy gross profit per script rising from $17.83 (FY24) to $28.86 (Q3 26), and Home Health ADC up 58% YoY—are strong. Watch items warranting PASS_WITH_WATCH include thin consolidated margins (11.8%-12.5% gross, 2.3%-3.9% operating), modest 7.58% headline ROIC on $3.1B of goodwill/intangibles, IRA Part D reimbursement headwinds (-$50M in Q1 26 Home & Community), working-capital AR intensity ($1.22B), and February 2027 TEU settlement alongside remaining KKR sponsor ownership (~13.7%).
